capabilities: Provide Stadia Maps vector tiles and styles to the Places plugin
Resolve search terms to POI suggestions and coordinates
Build directions between waypoints and isochrone reachability polygons
Snap recorded tracks to the road network and match named ways
Read elevation for coordinates and load 3D terrain DEM tiles
extras: The README only documents network requests and library dependencies; setup and usage instructions are not included, and the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed.
intentEvidence: Map provider for Places using Stadia Maps
problem: The Places plugin needs a map provider for tiles, search, and routing features, which Obsidian does not offer on its own.

relations.evidence: Map provider for Places using Stadia Maps

summary: Map provider plugin that adds Stadia Maps tiles, POI search, routing, isochrones, and track matching to the Places plugin.
